experimental_method: Gas (CH4 or C2H6 + CO2 gravimetric mixture) saturated with water and partly condensed at a set temperature; water content of the gas measured by Karl Fischer titration at the condenser outlet at atmospheric pressure; dew-point temperature at set pressure then measured with a chilled-mirror instrument (MBW DP3-D-HP-K2).
uncertainties_stated: dew-point temperature better than 0.1 K; pressure transmitter max error 0.1 % in calibrated range; wet gasmeter 0.2 %; gas mixture compositions +/- 1 mol %; no uncertainty stated for the water content.
quality_remarks: Water content unit kg m-3(n) is not defined in the paper (normal conditions and dry/humid basis not stated). Dew points below 273.15 K are included (ice/liquid not stated). Hydrate and liquid hydrocarbon+CO2 phase avoided according to the authors. Paper concludes dew point depends on water concentration, not on CH4(C2H6)/CO2 ratio.
